basePrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game character animation spritesheet.
EDIT the yellow chubby Naiwa creature in reference image 1 by dressing it in the specified costume. It MUST remain the SAME funny yellow creature: protruding large green eyes, long blunt snout, pear-shaped huge belly, dark olive hands and feet, short legs. NO human face, no human skin, no thin anime body. Costume fabric must fit the big round belly.
Create EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows = 16 full-body sprites, equal 256px square cells on a 1024x1024 transparent canvas. Uniform scale, left-facing three-quarter view, consistent ground baseline, generous transparent gutters. No cropped hair, hats, feet, effects. Crisp chunky pixel art matching reference; hard pixels, dark olive outlines, limited shading, no backgrounds, no shadows, no captions or borders.
Pose layout row1 four subtle idle breathing frames; row2 four alternating walking steps; row3 four wide-open-mouth laughing attack frames with belly shaking; row4 crouch anticipation, airborne tucked-leg jump, squashed landing, recoiling hurt. Each action must be recognizably different; clothes and hair follow pose. Keep all 16 cells isolated.
The yellow creature identity is more important than the cosplay human identity. Do not copy other reference people's faces.
